text:
maria: Quick Q for month close — ACME prepaid commit invoice (INV-ACME-0324) for $180,000 dated 2024-03-15. Contract: 12-month prepay for dedicated capacity. Customer consumed ~30% of committed units in March (billing meter shows 5.4/18 units). How should we recognize revenue & what accruals do we need for unbilled usage? Need entries posted in March close.

jake: Can you paste contract term and the invoice line? Also confirm whether free credits or usage overage applies.

maria: snippet: `Term: 12 months, start 2024-03-01, prepaid amount $180,000, committed capacity 18 unit-months/month`. Invoice lines: `100% prepay - service - $180,000`. No separate overage line for March.

jake: Ok — standard: at cash receipt post DR Cash $180k / CR Deferred Rev $180k. Then each month recognize CR Revenue / DR Deferred Rev for the earned portion. For March, earned = (consumed units / total committed units) * invoice = (5.4 / 18) * $180k = $54,000. So recognize $54k in March.

jake: Also need to accrue for earned but unbilled usage up to 3/31 if system lags. You said meter shows 5.4 used and invoiced 0? But if invoice covers full prepay then no unbilled for this prepaid line. However there's a separate usage overage estimate of ~$1,250 that hasn't been invoiced — accrue as DR AR Unbilled / CR Revenue $1,250.

susan: @maria we'll need contract approval sign-off + revenue schedule upload to GL. Can you attach the invoice and signed SOW?

maria: attached in thread (uploaded) — sending to accounting now. Will prepare two JE lines for GL. Proposed entries:

```
Journal A (receipt 3/15)
DR 1010 Cash $180,000
CR 2200 Deferred Revenue $180,000

Journal B (recognize March)
DR 2200 Deferred Revenue $54,000
CR 4000 Revenue - Ded. Capacity $54,000

Journal C (unbilled usage accrual)
DR 1200 AR - Unbilled $1,250
CR 4000 Revenue - Ded. Capacity $1,250
```

acct-bot: Reminder: please include the revenue schedule CSV template. See `/templates/rev_schedule_template.csv`.

jake: Also flag for quarter-end audit — include calculation table and sample meter exports.

maria: Will do. Action: I'll upload schedule + meter export and request GL posting by EOD close. Thanks :thumbsup:

susan: Approved — once uploaded I'll route to RevRec for confirmation.
